metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.3 · 1985 · The Return of the Living Dead
metas.description: When two bumbling employees at a medical supply warehouse accidentally release a deadly gas into the air, the vapors cause the dead to rise again as zombies.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.7 · 1988 · Return of the Living Dead II
metas.description: Curious kids unearth the barrels that previously helped revive the dead, which proves the second time's an undead charm.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.9 · 1993 · Return of the Living Dead III
metas.description: Having recently witnessed the horrific results of a top secret project to bring the dead back to life, a distraught youth performs the operation on his girlfriend after she's killed in a motorcycle accident.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 3.3 · 2005 · Return of the Living Dead: Necropolis
metas.description: A group of teenagers, in an attempt to rescue their friend from an evil corporation, end up inadvertently releasing a horde of bloodthirsty zombies.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 3.3 · 2005 · Return of the Living Dead: Rave to the Grave
metas.description: A college student creates a drug called "Z" and sells it on campus, inadvertently resurrecting the living dead, who wreak havoc at a Halloween rave.
